note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 against HEAD 5c2cb2199f (independent judge, after ebae55f243, ea3bab5f48, a965d7c0d4; supersedes the uncommitted stamp taken between ebae55f243 and ea3bab5f48). Section 4.4.2: "For each of the selectors defined in Section 4.4.1.1, the entry for an inbound SA in the SAD MUST be initially populated with the value or values negotiated at the time the SA was created." RFC 7296 Section 3.13: "a packet matches a given TSi/TSr if it matches at least one of the individual selectors in TSi, and at least one of the individual selectors in TSr." A packet carries one family, so the negotiated traffic of a dual-stack answer is exactly its same-family combinations: crossPairs/sameFamily (ebae55f243) record only those, and acceptablePairs (ea3bab5f48) now refuses a mixed-family proposed combination, so no answered pair, and so no SAD entry, is built for traffic that cannot exist. The index panic the previous stamp reported (all-mixed proposal, empty closedSubset, narrowed[0]) is fixed at both the producer (acceptablePairs) and the consumer (narrowChildSelectors refuses an empty closed subset with errTSUnacceptable). a965d7c0d4 substitutes a pool-bound peer's lease into proposed TSi before narrowing; the SAD entry then carries the lease, which is what the response answered, so SAD = negotiated still holds (whether that answer is a legal narrowing is RFC7296-2.9-1, judged weak there, not this row). childPolicies and inboundStateSelector bodies unchanged. Tagged carriers TestRFC4301TransportStateSelectorIsTheNegotiatedPair, TestRFC4301MixedProtocolPairInstallsTheIntersection, TestRFC4301AuthResponseWithoutTSIsRefused, TestRFC4301InitiatorInstallsAnAddressRangeExactly, TestRFC4301InitiatorRefusesAnAnswerItCannotInstallExactly, TestRFC4301TransportInitiatorRefusesSeveralPairs, TestRFC4301InitiatorInstallsEveryAnsweredCombination PASS at HEAD (./le job run, scoped -run). ./le rfc discriminate id RFC4301-4.4.2-2: ten records (re-taken by bb8d0d896c), none stale, none unproven; they cover inboundStateSelector, childPolicies, answerPairs, answerSelectors, rangePrefixes, recordInitiatorSelectors and adoptAuthResponseNegotiation. The mixed-family filters themselves carry no record and are pinned only by untagged tests (TestMixedFamilyCombinationsMatchNoPacket, TestResponderAnswersTSUnacceptableToAMixedFamilyChild, TestNarrowRefusesAMixedFamilyProposal); that is not a 4.4.2 obligation. Verdict stands.
